title: Draz Nurakk
summary: Prepare for Draz Nurakk and his pet to fight together.
overview: When Draz gains a new enemy and his pet is present, he calls the pet onto his current hate leader after one second.
Draz stops his one-hour despawn timer during combat. Leaving combat restarts the timer; when it expires, both Draz and his pet are removed.

roles.label: Tanks
tips: Pick up the pet as well as Draz at the start of combat.
